label: Beyer & Bommer (2006) component-definition benchmark
units: none: the study reports dimensionless ratios of sigma between component definitions, not an intensity
validityScope: A component-definition sensitivity benchmark, not a ground-motion model: it supplies no median and so cannot supply LocalIntensity on its own. Not usable at version 0.1.0: coefficients are unavailable_by_nature - the catalogue gives neither the functional form nor coefficients - so construction raises CoefficientsUnavailable and no capability is declared. What is missing is named under parameters.coefficients.needed.

source.catalogue: Douglas, J. (2011). Ground-motion prediction equations 1964-2010. PEER Report 2011/102 / BRGM/RP-59356-FR.
source.benchmark_spec: gmpe_30_coding_prompts.md, sections 3 and 4 - the 30-family benchmark set definition.
source.caveat: Douglas (2011) is a catalogue, not a ranking, and warns that a report of its size may contain errors or omissions. Every envelope below is its summary, frequently approximate. Nothing here substitutes for the original publication.
source.coefficient_appendix: gmpe_30_coding_prompts_with_coefficients.md sections 11 and 12 - coefficients transcribed from Douglas (2011), with an explicit per-model completeness status and a coefficient-completeness gate.

parameters.label: Beyer & Bommer (2006) component-definition benchmark

published_grid_summary.note: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table) gives the count and range only; the study publishes sigma ratios, not a coefficient table, and the exact period list was not verified. Still RESOLVE.

parameters.component: multiple - that is the point of the study

coefficients.needed: Douglas explicitly does not give the functional form or coefficients; the appendix confirms NOT_GIVEN_IN_DOUGLAS. The study reports sigma ratios between component definitions. The original article is required before it could become a median GMPE.

implementation_notes: Treat as a component-definition sensitivity benchmark, NOT a median GMPE.
Must refuse to return an absolute median until an authoritative baseline equation is provided.
If the original paper arrives, keep the baseline median GMPE separate from the component-conversion/variability layer.

resolution_provenance.distance.metric: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table) and Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table): r scale rhypo, 6*-200* km
resolution_provenance.distance.field: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table) and Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table): r scale rhypo
resolution_provenance.mechanism.classes: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table): mechanism code 'A (U)' -- all mechanisms pooled, none modelled separately. Data population (Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, section 2.220): 333 strike-slip, 36 normal, 329 reverse, 223 reverse-oblique, 25 normal-oblique, 3 undefined records.
resolution_provenance.components_available: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table) and Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table): component codes 1, 2, A, B, C, D50, G, I50, L, N, P, R
resolution_provenance.log_base: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, section 2.220: coefficients not given; the study reports ratios of sigma between component definitions. A ratio of standard deviations of log ground motion is the same in any log base, so no base attaches to the reported quantity.
resolution_provenance.internal_units: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, section 2.220: only ratios (sigma_x / sigma_GM) are reported; ratios carry no units.
